name: @pipeworx/mcp-openstates

tools.name: search_bills
tools.description: Search bills in any US statehouse. Pass jurisdiction as a 2-letter state code (e.g., "CA", "NY", "TX") or full name. Returns bill identifiers, titles, classifications, last action, sponsors, and OpenStates IDs for use with get_bill.

session.description: Optional. Session identifiers are PER STATE (Ohio "136", California "20252026", Texas "89"). Omit to search every session. A year or year range ("2025", "2025-2026") is resolved to the state's own session by date; an unknown session is refused with the valid list.

sort.description: updated_desc | updated_asc | first_action_desc | first_action_asc | latest_action_desc | latest_action_asc

per_page.description: 1-20 (default 20) — OpenStates rejects anything above 20 with a 400; a higher value is clamped to 20 and the response says so. Use `page` for more results.

tools.name: get_bill
tools.description: Fetch a single bill with full detail: versions, sponsorships, related/companion bills, actions, and votes. Pass the OpenStates ID (e.g., "ocd-bill/abc...") or a state/session/identifier triple.

session.description: Session ID, per state (Ohio "136", California "20252026"); a year or year range is resolved to the state's session. Use with jurisdiction + identifier.

tools.name: search_legislators
tools.description: Find state legislators. Filter by jurisdiction, name, chamber (upper/lower), party, or district. Returns name, current/prior roles, party, contact details, OpenStates IDs.

per_page.description: 1-20 (default 20) — OpenStates rejects anything above 20 with a 400; a higher value is clamped to 20 and the response says so. Use `page` for more results.

tools.name: get_legislator
tools.description: Fetch a single legislator by OpenStates person ID. Returns biographical info, current roles, prior offices, contact methods, sources.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-openstates forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the openstates pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
